subject: Delta Proxy variant compatibility check and temporary version pin
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, LumenAI <integrations@lumenai.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Delta Proxy variant compatibility check and temporary version pin

Team / LumenAI,

During a batch of canary queries this morning against the Delta Proxy variants (delta-proxy-v1 / delta-proxy-v1-quant), we observed unexpected token expansions and a KV-cache mismatch for multi-turn prompts that include user metadata prefixes. The attached trace and sample inputs highlight where outputs diverge between the internal runtime and LumenAI-hosted reference inference (see attached delta-proxy-trace-0427.log and sample-failing-prompts.json).

Ask:
- Can LumenAI confirm whether a recent change to rotary/position embedding or KV cache eviction logic rolled into the v1-quant variant? If so, what's the earliest build that introduced it?
- Engineering (Dev/Laura): please run the integration harness (INF-9345) against the samples and confirm whether the regression reproduces in staging.
- Product (Jasmine): recommend we temporarily pin Delta Proxy routing to delta-proxy-v1 (non-quant) for inbound requests from our Hosted API for the next 48 hours while we validate a fix; we can relax once patch + canary passes.

I've raised INF-9345 and attached a short compat report. LumenAI — any quick hypotheses are welcome. If we need a hotfix, what's your ETA? We need to schedule a canary window.

Attachments:
- delta-proxy-compat-report.pdf (compat summary)
- sample-failing-prompts.json (inputs)
- delta-proxy-trace-0427.log (runtime traces)

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Product Manager, Model Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, LumenAI <integrations@lumenai.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:03:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Delta Proxy variant compatibility check and temporary version pin

Thanks Marcus — looking into it now.

Initial plan:
- I'll run the INF-9345 harness against staging delta-proxy-v1-quant within the hour and post results to the Jira ticket.
- Laura, can you validate whether gating telemetry (KV-cache hit/miss sequences and sequence-length histograms) are available for those timestamps? That'll help us pinpoint whether the divergence is due to evictions or embedding misalignment.
- Jasmine, agree with the temporary pin proposal pending results. If we pin, I'll also add a routing rule + rollout flag and mark as reversible.

LumenAI — if you can share the exact model build hash (or the last 48h deploy window) that would speed debugging.

Attaching a small test harness snippet for reproducibility.

[Attachment: local-harness.patch (text)]

- Dev
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: LumenAI Integrations <integrations@lumenai.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenAI QA <lumenai-qa@lumenai.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 13:27:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Delta Proxy variant compatibility check and temporary version pin

Hi all,

Thanks for the heads up and the artifacts — we reproduced the divergence locally. Root cause appears to be an inadvertent change in our rotary embedding prefetch behavior that affects quantized variants when chunked KV cache is enabled (introduced in build 20270405-b2).

Plan & ETA:
- Patch: we have a fix that reverts the prefetch ordering; QA starts 7 Apr 15:00 UTC and we expect a canary patch deploy by 2027-04-08 02:00 UTC.
- Request: please provide one failing prompt output (from your harness) so our QA can exercise the exact path — we used the sample-failing-prompts.json but a raw output would help.
- If you plan to pin routing, that is reasonable; we recommend pinning only requests with user-metadata prefixes (we can provide a routing rule snippet).

We will update INF-9345 and post the canary results and the patch diff.

Regards,
Nate Coleman
Integrations Engineer
LumenAI
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, LumenAI <integrations@lumenai.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delta Proxy variant compatibility check and temporary version pin

All — thanks for the quick investigations and the tentative timeline.

Decision:
- Temporary routing pin: pin inbound routing to delta-proxy-v1 (non-quant) for the affected customer cohorts and user-metadata-prefixed requests at 16:00 PT today. Dev — please implement as reversible flag and post the rollout plan.
- LumenAI: we'll accept the canary timeline; once you push the canary and confirm parity, we'll coordinate an unpin + gradual re-enable.
- Deliverable: Laura — please add the telemetry snapshots to INF-9345; Dev — attach the routing rule snippet and the revert playbook.

I'll close the loop once the pin is live.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Product Manager, Model Ops
Redwood Inference
